use default

let events = [
    "8/27/1883    Krakatoa            8.8",
    "5/18/1980    MountStHelens       7.6",
    "3/13/2009    CostaRica           5.1",
    "3/28/1964    PrinceWilliamSound  9.2",
    "5/22/1960    Valdivia            9.5",
    "12/26/2004   Sumatra             9.1",
    "3/11/2011    Tohoku              9.1",
    "2/27/2010    Maule               8.8",
    "4/18/1906    SanFrancisco        7.9",
    "1/12/2010    Haiti               7.0",
    "8/23/2011    Virginia            5.8",
    "10/17/1989   LomaPrieta          6.9"
]

magnitude(line: string) -> double =>
    double.parse(
        line.split([' '], StringSplitOptions.REMOVE_EMPTY_ENTRIES)[2])

events
    |> filter(line => magnitude(line) > 6.0D)
    |> each(line => write_line(line))
